### Timeout leaves streams muted or torn down **High Severity** A 30s connection timeout that fires before `perpsStartPreload` leaves the bridge activated with no `preloadId`, so `canEmit` stays false and Home/Discover get no updates while subscriptions leak. If timeout or `perpsStopPreload` runs after preload started and no Perps view is open, `destroy()` drops every stream; `PerpsStreamManager` still reports the address as initialized, so already-mounted hooks never re-run `perpsInit` or `perpsActivatePriceStream`.
Additional Locations (2) - [`app/scripts/controllers/perps/perps-stream-bridge.ts#L276-L290`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/63ddfd4fd5cc95a04ea7022b6cbdc61f5f056d66/app/scripts/controllers/perps/perps-stream-bridge.ts#L276-L290) - [`app/scripts/controllers/perps/perps-stream-bridge.ts#L465-L483`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/63ddfd4fd5cc95a04ea7022b6cbdc61f5f056d66/app/scripts/controllers/perps/perps-stream-bridge.ts#L465-L483)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 63ddfd4fd5cc95a04ea7022b6cbdc61f5f056d66. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).
action: Preserved initialized wallet ownership across preload cancellation, stop and failure, with four reproduced regressions and explicit teardown coverage.
